messages.content: You are a Senior Automation Engineer. I need a highly complex, production-ready Siemens SCL function block for a 3-Phase Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) via Modbus RTU communication. The block must include a robust state machine, comprehensive safety interlocks (E-Stop, STO, Thermal Overload), hardware abstraction for Modbus control/status words, dynamic speed referencing, fault handling, and runtime tracking. Please provide flawless IEC 61131-3 SCL code with detailed comments.

Evolve a basic IO reading block into a highly complex EtherCAT diagnostic and mapping block. It should read EtherCAT master states, track slave CRC communication errors, map physical IO to logical structures, and implement a robust safety state machine that triggers fallback safety outputs (such as e-stops and thermal overloads) if the bus fails.

Evolve a basic motor timer block from the tier1 seeds into a high-speed Flow Wrapper packaging machine logic block. Implement electronic camming (e-cam) synchronization between the film feed axis and the rotary seal jaws using TwinCAT MC2 libraries. Include complex state machines, safety interlocks (e-stops, thermal overloads), and hardware abstractions.

Evolve a basic array processing block into a complex Model Predictive Control (MPC) matrix calculation for an Oil & Gas fractional distillation column in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text. Include reflux ratio optimization, matrix operations for multivariable control, and strict safety interlocks such as high column pressure overrides and thermal overload protection.

Evolve a basic array handling block from the tier1 seeds into an advanced Logistics ASRS (Automated Storage and Retrieval System) coordinate mapper. Implement 3D rack coordinate translation (X,Y,Z), bin status tracking (empty/full/reserved), and shortest-path calculation for the crane. Include complex state machines, safety interlocks (e.g. e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text.

Evolve a basic state machine from the tier1 seeds into an ultra-precise Semiconductor Wafer Handling Robot sequencer in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text. Implement FOUP (Front Opening Unified Pod) load/unload sequences, vacuum grip confirmation with vacuum sensors, and SECS/GEM host communication mapping. Include hardware abstractions, safety interlocks (e.g., e-stops, vacuum loss faults), state machines for the sequence, and flawless comments.

Evolve a basic state machine from the tier1 seeds into a SIL-4 rated Theme Park Roller Coaster Block Zone controller. Implement redundant wheel-sensor tracking, anti-rollback ratchet monitoring, and fail-safe magnetic brake deployment if block zones are violated.

Write an FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliant Pharmaceutical Lyophilizer (Freeze Dryer) sequence using IEC 61131-3 Structured Text. Implement a highly complex state machine including ultra-low temperature cascade refrigeration control, primary drying vacuum ramp holding, and batch report signature generation. Add critical safety interlocks (e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments.

Evolve a basic temperature loop into a highly exothermic Chemical Polymerization Reactor controller. Implement runaway reaction detection, emergency quench tank dumping, and multi-variable Model Predictive Control (MPC) for pressure and catalyst dosing.

Evolve a basic temperature block into a Quantum Computing Cryostat Dilution Refrigerator controller. Implement ultra-low temperature (milli-Kelvin) He3/He4 isotope mixture regulation, turbo-molecular vacuum pump sequencing, and superconducting magnet quench detection.

Evolve a basic motor block into a Class III Medical Device Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO) Blood Pump controller. Implement hemolysis prevention (anti-cavitation limits), ultrasonic bubble detection, and dual-redundant rotary encoder tracking. Add complex state machines, safety interlocks (e.g. e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments.

Evolve a basic IO block into a Deep Sea ROV (Remotely Operated Vehicle) Subsea Control Module. Implement hydraulic pressure compensation for 6000m depths, umbilical fiber-optic telemetry heartbeat checks, and thruster vectoring matrices in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text.
Evolve a basic timer into a Smart City Traffic Grid Coordinator. Implement Green Wave synchronized cascading, emergency vehicle preemption (EVP) overrides, and pedestrian density sensor integration.

Design a highly complex IEC 61131-3 PLC program for an Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) Laser Lithography Wafer Stage controller. The system must implement nanometer-precision linear motor positioning, active vibration cancellation using piezo actuators, and strict safety interlocks for the vacuum chamber pressure.

I have a basic sequencer for a conveyor belt in IEC 61131-3. Can you evolve it into a massive Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) controller? You must implement cutterhead torque distribution across multi-drive motors, earth-pressure balance (EPB) slurry face control, and segmental concrete ring erector sequencing. Ensure the code includes complex state machines, safety interlocks (e.g., e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments.

Evolve the basic FIFO_16 tracking block into a High-Speed Cross-Belt Sorter and Machine Vision routing matrix for a Global E-Commerce Logistics Hub. The system must include:
1. A TCP/IP (or UDP) socket integration block to receive datagrams from an overhead Cognex/Keyence machine vision barcode scanner.
2. A massive dynamic FIFO shift register tracking X/Y coordinates across 500 meters of conveying surface.
3. Induction cell synchronization calculating exact millisecond timing to fire the induction belt, landing the package perfectly centered on an empty cross-belt carrier moving at 3 m/s.
4. Recirculation logic for packages missing their chute due to downstream fullness (incorporating photoelectric retro-reflective sensor debounce logic).
5. Highly modular IEC 61131-3 standard FB/FC architecture.

You are acting as a Lead Port Automation Engineer for a global shipping conglomerate. Evolve a basic motion block into a massive Automated Stacking Crane (ASC) and Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) intersection controller for a mega-port.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. Anti-sway closed-loop control for the crane hoist using overhead laser distance meters and absolute encoders on the trolley.
2. AGV traffic management matrix: Implement dynamic right-of-way claiming using a zone-based reservation system to prevent deadlocks at container handover points.
3. Wind speed anemometer interlocks: If sustained wind speed > 20 m/s, initiate an automatic safe-park sequence and drop spreader twist-locks.
4. TOS (Terminal Operating System) handshake logic using strict XML/TCP parsing to receive container ISO codes and target yard coordinates.

You are acting as a Lead Show-Action Engineer for a top-tier theme park design firm (e.g., Disney Imagineering). Evolve a basic motion block into a 64-Axis Audio-Animatronic Figure Controller.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. SMPTE Timecode synchronization: The PLC must sync massive hydraulic valve arrays (proportional valves) to an incoming audio timecode with sub-millisecond precision.
2. Electronic camming profiles for smooth, lifelike acceleration/deceleration of the animatronic joints to prevent mechanical "jerking".
3. Hydraulic pressure envelope monitoring: If a servo-valve fails open, instantly trigger a dump-valve to prevent the animatronic arm from crashing into the ride vehicle path.
